text:
Alex: Heads-up — I did a quick sweep of the first-run ribbon + sample-app card flow. Found a few small UX and a11y things. Can we do a short sync in ~15?
Maya: On for 15. If anyone can't make it, drop notes here and I'll bring them up.
Dave: Quick flag on copy: CTA on the ribbon says 'Get started' which is too vague. Suggestion: 'Create first endpoint' or 'Run your first request' — more task-oriented.
Erin: a11y nit: ribbon text contrast fails AAA for smaller sizes when the background gradient is used. Also the close button has no visible focus when tabbing.
Jordan: UX bug: when you filter sample project cards (e.g., Python) and open a card, hitting back clears the filter. I think the router isn't preserving query params on popstate.
Alex: Good catches. For the filter state we currently stick it in query params but our navigation wrapper does a replace that drops them on back. Options: persist to localStorage or fix history handling. Leaning toward history fix so deep links still work.
Maya: I prefer keeping it history-driven (deep links are useful for sharing). Could we push the filter into history.replaceState on select instead of mutating the route? That should make back/forward behave. cc @Dave for feasibility.
Dave: Implementing history.replace sounds fine and avoids extra storage. Also +1 on more prescriptive CTA copy. "Starter projects" vs "Sample projects" — I think "Starter" nudges action.
Erin: Additional a11y items: screen reader reads the close button as just "close" with no context. Recommend aria-label="close onboarding ribbon" and announce when ribbon expanded/collapsed. Also ensure focus trap isn't happening (users should be able to skip).
product-bot: Design review scheduled: #design-lab @ 11:30. Agenda: CTA copy variants, focus states, back-navigation fix. Please upload mocks before meeting. Link: https://redwood.example/design-lab/1764001234
Jordan: I'll mock up two CTA variants and updated focus outlines before the meeting. Also will prototype replacing the router replace with push/replace behavior for filters and show a quick demo.
Alex: Thanks — drop microcopy suggestions here if you have them. I'll file tickets for this sprint: PROD-847 (copy changes), PROD-848 (a11y fixes), PROD-849 (router/backnav). :rocket:
